messages.content: 你能使用lawsuit_search功能從加州的聖塔克拉拉檢索所有涉及實體“Google”的訴訟，然後再從加州的聖馬刁檢索涉及實體“Facebook”的訴訟嗎？

function.name: lawsuit_search

The user says "你能使用lawsuit_search功能從加州的聖塔克拉拉檢索所有涉及實體“Google”的訴訟，然後再從加州的聖馬刁檢索涉及實體“Facebook”的訴訟嗎？" So we need to call the function twice.

We should produce two function calls. According to policy, we can only output one function call at a time. But we can chain them? The policy says: "When you want to call a function, you must do so in a single assistant message. You cannot provide multiple function calls in a single message." So we need to call one function, get the result, then call the next. But we can't do that in a single message. We need to do it step by step. So we will first call the function for Google in Santa Clara. Then we will wait for the tool response. Then we will call again for Facebook in San Mateo. So we need to produce the first function call.
